downstream_constraints: Do not equate cold-item with cold-user.
Do not equate Sentence-BERT quality with recommendation quality.
Do not claim that architecture transfer establishes H4 replication.
Do not count pretraining-source and target datasets as independent evidence when they share a platform or benchmark lineage.
Do not use MTPR, CLCRec, SimGCL, XSimGCL, LightGCL, or CGRC for production claims until a lawful authoritative full artifact is inspected and an original-content locator is recorded.
Do not merge zero-edge, sparse-edge, warm, and overall item denominators.
Do not cite paper-native benchmark values as v5 results or compare values across unmatched candidate/split/metric protocols.
Do not treat the 15 canonical records as 15 independent corroborations.
Do not store or redistribute remotely accessible artifacts without a separate rights basis.
Central synthesis must preserve support scope, counter-evidence, limitations, and forbidden extrapolations from the claim cards.
